[Benzinga news, 2026-10-29T16:31:58Z, by staff] Unilever Executive Fabian Garcia Appointed CEO of The Clorox Company
Unilever executive Fabian Garcia has been appointed as the next CEO of The Clorox Company, effective January 5, 2027.
Fabian Garcia, currently the president of Unilever Personal Care and a member of the Unilever Leadership Executive team, has been named the incoming CEO of The Clorox Company. Garcia will assume his new role on January 5, 2027, succeeding Linda Rendle. His departure marks a change in Unilever's leadership team, as he has held several senior roles at the company since 2020.
